Amendment to employment agreement (salary restoration; incentive elimination)
Salary restored effective February 1, 2026; amendment executed August 31, 2026
Committee-approved Amendment No. 2 to reverse prior salary reduction and remove incentive bonus
Make-whole payment to be made for unpaid salary difference since Feb 1, 2026; prior Amendment No.1 had reduced salary to $80,000 and provided a $1.6M bonus eligibility
